name: Ubigreen
positioning: Energy and space usage measured together — because an empty floor that is still heated is both problems at once.
description: Ubigreen provides French building operators with energy performance monitoring, regulatory declaration support, and workplace occupancy measurement, combining consumption data with presence and space-use data in one platform.
real_estate_use: Since hybrid work, the two questions arrived together: how much energy does this building use, and how much of it is actually occupied. Measuring both allows the decision that follows — consolidating occupancy onto fewer floors and shutting down the rest, which moves consumption far more than any equipment upgrade.
features: Energy consumption monitoring across multi-site portfolios
Décret tertiaire and OPERAT declaration support
Workplace occupancy and space utilisation measurement
Alerting on consumption drift and equipment faults

use_cases.job: Consolidate occupancy onto fewer floors and shut down the energy on the rest
Declare regulated consumption and track the effect of measures taken
